reviews.text: My dog literally waits at the window everyday of the week hoping that it's one of the 3 days she goes for a walk. When she gets home, she is pooped for the whole afternoon.
The most caring, loving team- the walkers become part of the family

We have been clients of Eglinton Dog Walker for four years and we are blown away by their caring attitudes and professional service. Everyone who works there from administrators to dog trainers and dog walkers are first rate.

Our dog goes on Puppy Walks three times a week with Yasmine and absolutely loves the experience. Yasmine is an expert at managing dogs and always ensures that our dog is well taken care and ready for a fun outing in the dog park.

I can't imagine how Yasmine could provide any better support for our dog and family! She provides white glove service and I would definitely give her a five star rating!

Choosing the EDW crew has been the absolute highlight of our dog's daily routine! This team is comprised of the most genuinely caring and enthusiastic people—their love for their work and the dogs is undeniable. They have been an integral part of her life since she was three, and honestly, she greets her walkers with more excitement than she does us!

What truly sets them apart are the diverse adventures they provide around the city and the incredible, professional-quality photos they share. For outstanding care, exciting outings, and peace of mind, you absolutely cannot go wrong with EDW. It’s a fantastic choice that both you and your dog will love.
Amazing dog walking service! The owner is kind, trustworthy, and fantastic with dogs. My pup absolutely loves them. Highly recommended!

Can't say enough good things about EDW.  They swooped in when we were in desperate need for a new walker and thank goodness for that!  Completely reliable, flexible, and trustworthy.  Our dog Indy is a happy and tired dog whenever he has a day of fun with the EDW pack.  I would recommend them 100% every time.

My pup absolutely loves his Englinton Dog Walker! I’m always at ease knowing he is in such good hands. They’re super reliable, and it’s clear they genuinely care about my pup. Every walk leaves my dog happy and tired, which is exactly what I want. Couldn’t recommend them enough! 🫶🏼 …

Very disappointing experience with Eglinton Dog Walker. Have a puppy with some unique needs, nothing unusual. It was clear early on that this wasn’t the right fit. Thankfully, we found a superior option and couldn’t be happier. Would not recommend based on my personal experience.

10/10 highly recommended Eglinton Dog Walker!! They provide top tier care and love our dog like it’s their own. My dog always comes home happy and excited for their next walk waiting eagerly in the window for their walker!
Fantastic team of dog walkers! Great communication and our pup is always happy. Highly recommend!
Eglington Dog Walker is run with so much love and care. You can trust your furry friends will get great treatment with this company!

Absolutely outstanding dog walking service! My pup lights up the moment he sees them at the door, and he always comes home happy and tired. The staff are fantastic—professional, caring, and clearly love what they do. Can’t recommend them highly enough.
Absolutely adore Eglinton Dog Walker! Thanks for letting us join the pack!

We couldn’t be happier with the wonderful service provided by EDW! They’re a team of amazing dog lovers and they treat our girl like family.  The quick response times and great customer service makes them a pleasure to work with and they’re so accommodating to our schedules.  Highly recommended!

Extremely disappointing experience. The owner is shockingly rude and completely lacks professionalism. I had a simple question about their services and was met with attitude and condescension. If this is how they treat potential clients, I can’t imagine how they treat the dogs.
I’m so pleased with the love and care our dog has received from Eglinton dog walkers.  All the staff are so amazing and show so much love for our boy!
loyal and loving...treat my pets as if they were their own

Eglinton dog walker is made up of an amazing group of individuals who truly love dogs and treat them with love, kindness, and respect.

They are professional, trust-worthy, and reliable…my dog has been with the pack since he was a little guy and is now 7 years old.

Highly recommended and completely content with the service I have received...much peace of mind while I’m at work and I come home to a very happy little pup.

We are so happy with EDW.  Our pup has been with them for about 2.5 years, and she is so excited very time the walker comes to the door.  I have also found them to be very flexible - for example, when we have work being done in the house our pup goes for a double walk to give time for the work to be completed.  We have made more last minute request that I care to admit, but EDW has always been able to accommodate.  I can't recommend them enough.
EDW are extended family. They take such good care of our pup Lily. Not sure what we'd do without them.

Excellent dog walkers! We’re so lucky to be part of the pack. They take great care of my dog and he gets so much off leash exercise. The owners and walkers are the friendliest people. We’re extremely happy. They post a lot of photos too!

Eglinton Dog Walker is an amazing walking service. My three year old cockapoo Billie loves his daily walks with his best doggie friends! They are very considerate of wiping the dog’s paws when he’s wet! We highly recommend 🐾 …
Eric and Keri have provided  wonderful experience for my Labrador and he looks forward to his daily pack walks. I would highly recommend Eglinton Dog Walker to anyone who owns a dog!

A Decade of Trust and Exceptional Service

I have been with Eglinton Dog Walker for almost 11 years, and I cannot recommend them enough! From the very beginning, their professionalism, reliability, and genuine love for animals have been clear in every interaction. They have been more than just dog walkers—they’ve become an integral part of my pet’s life and mine.

Over the years, I’ve had peace of mind knowing my dog is in the hands of people who truly care. The walkers are always punctual, friendly, and attentive to my dog’s unique needs. They’ve gone above and beyond countless times, whether it’s accommodating last-minute schedule changes, providing updates after walks, or ensuring my dog gets the exercise and care he needs, rain or shine.

What sets Eglinton Dog Walker apart is their personal touch. They don’t just walk dogs—they build relationships. My dog lights up when they (Hail) arrives, and that tells me everything I need to know. It’s rare to find a company so committed to both exceptional service and the happiness of their clients (both human and furry!).

After almost 11 years, I can confidently say Eglinton Dog Walker has earned my trust and loyalty. If you’re looking for a dog walking service that treats your pet like family, look no further.

Let me know if you’d like any adjustments!

We have been clients of Eglinton Dog walker for 6 years now and they have always taken great care of our dog, Keri is amazing to work with very quick to respond and all our walkers through the years have been great!

The Best!  I had another company that I loved but they didn't do in home boarding and that's a huge addition.  Eg Dog Walker are full service and professional but more imporatnt all their walkers are so amazing and love the dogs so much - it's a place you can have full confidence in.  They have even helped me on weekends when I needed a sort of emergency help plan and when I've boarded my dog with them she was so well looked after and so well loved - it's an amazing company - well run, flexible when you need help, organized, responsive - 10 out of 5 stars :)

EDW is a wonderful resource for Lola our Golden Retriever. Lola loves her pack which she visits three times a week. Keri, Elissa and Eric are excellent people to trust with our dog. Great care and service. We highly recommend EDW.

We love EDW!! My dog has been with them since she was a puppy and 9 years later she still is soooo excited to go run with the pack. EDW is a great crew!  I am grateful that my dog can still be safe and free in a neighbourhood that is hectic and chaotic (subway/condo construction). ❤️

We’ve been using Eglinton Dog Walker since the beginning- over 13 years.  My dog excitedly awaits his daily walks and loves spending days with his pack members.  Each walker has been so loving and attentive.  Thank you for all you do for my fur baby.

Excellent service, all around! We always feel like our Charlie is in the best hands with the EDW team! Their response time is always quick and they’re so accommodating to our crazy schedule. Highly recommended!
I reached out to them twice for more information and filled out an online form, however, I never heard back from them

I cannot say enough good things about Eglinton Dog Walker! They have been so incredible the past 2+ years, showing endless care to our pup! They are extremely flexible and accommodating with scheduling, even last minute changes, and are always responsive and kind. The price is so reasonable, especially given they have our dog for 2+ hours each day and walks are always off-leash. We are so grateful to have been apart of the pack!
